name: connectsecure-mcp
description: Every ConnectSecure API operation, plus a local store that answers vulnerability x asset x client questions across your whole client base in one command.

connectsecure_base_url.title: CONNECTSECURE_BASE_URL
connectsecure_base_url.description: Your tenant's pod URL, e.g. https://pod104.myconnectsecure.com (the pod API host shown under Profile > API Documentation in the ConnectSecure portal, not portal.myconnectsecure.com). Each tenant lives on its own pod, so there is no working default.

connectsecure_tenant.title: CONNECTSECURE_TENANT
connectsecure_tenant.description: Tenant name you type on the ConnectSecure portal login screen.

connectsecure_client_id.title: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_ID
connectsecure_client_id.description: API client ID from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

connectsecure_client_secret.title: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_SECRET
connectsecure_client_secret.description: API client secret from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

connectsecure_access_token.title: CONNECTSECURE_ACCESS_TOKEN
connectsecure_access_token.description: Optional. A pre-minted JWT from /w/authorize; while it is unexpired it is used instead of minting one. The tenant, client ID and secret are still needed so the CLI can mint a fresh token once it expires.

connectsecure_user_id.title: CONNECTSECURE_USER_ID
connectsecure_user_id.description: Optional. user_id from /w/authorize. Only needed with a pre-minted CONNECTSECURE_ACCESS_TOKEN; minting fills it automatically.

connectsecure_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
connectsecure_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write (any non-GET call) and hide the sync, export and tail tools (import is never an MCP tool). Credential reads are still answered, so this does not replace scoping the API user. Leave blank for full access. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

connectsecure_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
connectsecure_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectSecure requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

connectsecure_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
connectsecure_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank unless you set one up yourself.
